subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Conceal
solution:
The correct answer is "Reveal."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

 

__
 
• The word "Conceal" means to hide something/somebody; to prevent something/somebody from being seen or discovered. ((किसी से कुछ) छिपाना; गुप्‍त रखना)

 
 
• Example: *She tried to **conceal**__ her anger from her friend.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of "Conceal" is "Reveal."
 
• The word "Reveal" means to make something known that was secret or unknown before. ((गुप्‍त या पूर्वतः अज्ञात वस्‍तु को) प्रकट करना, रहस्‍य खोल लेना)
 __
 
• Example: *He refused to **reveal**__ any names to the police.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ 

__
 
• Watch: **to look at somebody/something for a time, paying attention to what happens. ((किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को) ध्यान से देखना)
 
• **See: **to become conscious of something, using your eyes; to use the power of sight. (देखना, नेत्रों द्वारा प्रत्‍यक्ष करना; दृष्टि-शक्ति का प्रयोग करना)
 
• **Hide: **to put or keep somebody/something in a place where he/she/it cannot be seen; to cover something so that it cannot be seen. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को ऐसी जगह रखना जहाँ कोई देख न सके, छिपाना; किसी वस्‍तु को ऐसे ढकना कि वह दिखाई न दे, छिपा देना)
